relations.rationale: Wren arriving before Dara has no bearing on Leo's height relative to the group.
The order of arrival between Wren and Dara is unrelated to the sound of runners' shoes on pavement.
Handing out flyers about the charity is a separate event unrelated to cheers from the sidelines at race start.
Children waving flags near the finish doesn't establish or negate cheers at the race's start.
Children waving flags near the finish is unrelated to the sun's position above the trees.
Wren adjusting her hair tie and watching the sky is unrelated to cheers rising from the sidelines.
Wren hoping clouds hold off suggests overcast conditions, which slightly contradicts the sun climbing higher and being visible.
Mina being taller than Hugo says nothing about how she compares to Leo.
Mina being taller than Hugo doesn't determine how Hugo compares to Leo.
Mina being taller than Hugo alone doesn't establish Leo's height relative to the group.
Mina being shorter than Leo doesn't specify Hugo's height relative to Leo.
Mina being shorter than Leo supports the idea that Leo is tall relative to others in the group.
Hugo being shorter than Leo supports the idea that Leo towers over the group.
Leo's height relative to the group is unrelated to whether the runners set off together.
Cheers rising as the race began supports the runners setting off together, since both describe the race start.
Cheers as the race began supports the runners' shoes thudding, since both occur as the race gets underway.
The runners setting off together supports the description of their shoes thudding rhythmically against the pavement.
